findings.description: A bare parameter with no '=' (e.g. Content-Type: text/html; charset) is now stored with the boolean value True, so get_encoding_from_headers calls .strip() on a bool and raises AttributeError.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a response whose Content-Type contains a bare 'charset' token without '='. The new code at line 520 sets params['charset']=True, and line 544 then calls True.strip(...), raising AttributeError. Previously such a token was skipped and the function fell back to ISO-8859-1 for text types. Impact: requests that read the encoding (e.g. response.text) crash on malformed but seen-in-the-wild headers instead of degrading gracefully.
